description: Adds the display type (24px semibold) for a metric card's figure; --spacing-hit-outset and --spacing-hit-coarse-gap, which grow a 24px control's hit area to 44px on a coarse pointer without moving it; and --card-aside-max, --card-media-width and --card-media-height for the card's aside and 16:9 picture. Adds --container-card-abbreviate (16rem) and --container-card-hide (13rem), the card widths below which a fact abbreviates and hides. Adds --z-index-raised (1), which lifts a control above a link whose hit area covers its container.
Adds --avatar-overlap, the fraction of an avatar's width that the next avatar in a group covers.
The docs say to install this item once, before your first component, instead of naming it in every component's add command.
Renames component variables to match the renamed items: --field-card-enter-scale is --preview-card-enter-scale, --status-mark-ring is --status-media-ring and --track-value-min is --meter-value-min.
The docs link to this item's playground page at /playground/tokens.
Assessed against the lifecycle criteria: beta.
Item introduced, generated from the DTCG token source.
